myob.title: MYOB Integration
myob.subtitle: Connect each company file's MYOB account and map stores to their paying company

notice.title: Before you authorise
notice.admin: Authorisation must be completed by the Administrator of the MYOB company file, signed in to MYOB. Other roles will fail or lack permission.
notice.perAbn: Each ABN maps to one company file, and each company file is authorised once. After connecting, choose the company file for each store below.

connections.title: Connected company files
connections.empty: No MYOB company file is connected yet. Click "Connect MYOB company file" at the top right to start.
connections.authorizeFailed: Failed to get the MYOB authorisation URL

actions.disconnectContent: This clears the authorisation token for this company file and removes the mappings of all stores under it ({{count}} now). You will need to reauthorise and map the stores again to use it.

mappings.title: Store → company file mapping
mappings.hint: A store's company file is its default paying company. Only connected company files can be chosen.
mappings.noConnections: No connected company file to choose from. Connect one above first.

errors.notConfigured: MYOB app credentials are not configured on the server. Contact an administrator
errors.invalidState: The authorisation state is invalid or expired. Please start again
errors.tokenExchangeFailed: Failed to exchange the MYOB token. The code may have expired. Please authorise again
errors.businessIdMissing: MYOB did not return a company file ID. Make sure a company file is selected and try again
errors.connectionNotActive: The connection is not in Connected state
errors.needsReauthorization: The authorisation has expired. Please reauthorise
errors.apiCallFailed: MYOB API call failed. Please try again later
errors.unknown: Unknown error. Try again later or contact an administrator

tabs.noAccess: You do not have access to any MYOB tab

company.title: Choose the paying company file
company.hint: Employees are listed by their paying company. Someone who works at a store of company A but is paid by company B appears in B's list with a "Cross-company" badge.
company.empty: No company file is connected yet. Ask a colleague with the "Connections & mapping" permission to connect one.
company.emptyCanConnect: No company file is connected yet. Click "Connect another company file" to start authorising one.

employees.title: Employee binding · {{name}}
employees.hint: Suggestions are scored by email, then birthday, name and phone. They only take effect after you confirm, and nothing in MYOB is changed.

batch.title: {{count}} strong matches (email and birthday both agree) can be confirmed in one go
batch.hint: Partial matches, conflicts and rows with a phone or name difference are never included; review those one by one.
batch.confirmContent: These {{count}} employees will be bound to their suggested MYOB cards. The server re-scores each one and rejects any that is no longer a strong match. You can unbind at any time; nothing in MYOB is changed.

employees.total: {{total}} employees · {{page}} on this page (sorted: suggested, review, unmatched, bound)

status.cardMissing: This card no longer exists in MYOB (deleted or inactive)

actions.unbindContent: The employee goes back to the to-do list and can be bound again. Nothing in MYOB is changed.

failures.title: {{ok}} bound, {{count}} failed
failures.cardNotFound: This card was not found in MYOB (refresh MYOB employees first)
failures.cardAlreadyBound: This card is already bound to another employee
failures.userAlreadyBound: This employee is already bound to a MYOB card
failures.notHighScore: No longer a strong match; use "Review and bind" instead
failures.linkNotFound: Binding not found (it may have been unbound already)

missing.hint: Find people who exist on only one side, and employment types that do not match MYOB.

ours.title: In our system, not in MYOB
ours.hint: Ask finance to create the employee card in MYOB, then click Refresh; suggestions appear automatically.
ours.note: "Copy details" only copies name, email, birthday and phone to the clipboard so you can paste them into a new MYOB card. The system never creates cards in MYOB.
ours.empty: Nobody needs a new MYOB card

theirs.title: In MYOB, not in our system
theirs.hint: Possibly left but not deactivated, belongs to another company, or not set up on our side yet.

typeIssues.title: Employment type check
typeIssues.hint: Advice only, nothing is blocked. Annual / sick leave balances show only for full-time and part-time staff (not casual).

codes.temporaryHasLeave: Casual staff should not have leave entitlements
codes.unknown: Employment type does not match MYOB

fix.missingLeave: Tell finance to set up in MYOB
fix.temporaryHasLeave: Tell finance to fix in MYOB

notes.missingLeave: Please add annual / sick leave entitlements to the MYOB card of {{name}} ({{type}}, {{stores}}); otherwise leave balances cannot be fetched.
notes.temporaryHasLeave: {{name}} ({{type}}, {{stores}}) is casual in our system, but the MYOB card has annual / sick leave entitlements. Please check and fix.
notes.generic: The employment type of {{name}} ({{type}}, {{stores}}) does not match MYOB. Please check.

typeIssues.noteCopied: Note for finance copied; paste it to send

drawer.title: Choose a MYOB card for {{name}}
drawer.subtitle: MYOB cards are read only; confirming does not change anything in MYOB.
drawer.search: Search {{company}} MYOB employees: name / email / last 4 phone digits
drawer.empty: No matching cards. Try another keyword.

warn.both: The emails differ and the birthday cannot be compared, so only name and phone support this match. Make sure it is the same person before binding; you can unbind at any time.
warn.email: The emails differ. Make sure it is the same person before binding; you can unbind at any time.
warn.birthday: The birthday cannot be compared. Make sure it is the same person before binding; you can unbind at any time.

payroll.title: Paying company (by employee x store)
payroll.hint: By default, hours are paid by the company that owns the store worked at. Only exceptions (works at a store of company A but is paid by company B) need to be set. Hours of one store are never split between two companies.
payroll.editAria: Set the paying company of {{name}} at {{store}}

payrollDrawer.title: Paying company of {{name}}
payrollDrawer.subtitle: Requires the "Edit payroll" permission; every change is audited.
payrollDrawer.loadFailed: Failed to load paying company details
payrollDrawer.byStoreNoCompany: By store (store not mapped to a company)
payrollDrawer.effectiveHint: Only pay-period start dates can be chosen, so one store's hours are never split mid-period.
payrollDrawer.noAllowedDates: There is no selectable effective date right now, so this cannot be saved.

unbound.title: {{company}} has not bound {{name}} yet.
unbound.body: Bind them under "Employee binding" before pushing hours.

payCategories.title: Timesheet pay category mapping
payCategories.hint: Before pushing hours, tell the system which MYOB pay category each tier of our hours maps to. Set once per company file.
payCategories.refreshFailed: Failed to re-read MYOB pay categories
payCategories.loadFailed: Failed to read MYOB pay categories
payCategories.noCompanies: No company file is connected yet. Connect and verify one above first.
payCategories.noCategories: No pay categories were read from {{name}}. Check that pay categories are set up in MYOB, then click "Re-read" at the top right.
payCategories.companyAria: Choose the company file to map pay categories for

weekday.label: Weekday
weekday.sub: Includes public-holiday work and paid public holiday
weekday.note: Public-holiday work and paid public holiday also use this category (the public-holiday transfer rate must equal the weekday rate)

saturday.label: Saturday
saturday.note: The pay multiplier comes from the MYOB category; it must match our Saturday transfer rate

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: The pay multiplier comes from the MYOB category; it must match our Sunday transfer rate

personalLeave.label: Sick leave
personalLeave.note: MYOB deducts the sick-leave balance by this category

holidayLeave.label: Annual leave
holidayLeave.note: MYOB deducts the annual-leave balance by this category

payCategories.selectAria: Choose the MYOB pay category for "{{label}}"

state.suggestedHint: Pre-filled, editable; takes effect only after saving
state.unsetHint: No similarly named category found; choose one manually. These hours cannot be pushed until it is set
state.missingHint: This category no longer exists in MYOB; choose it again

note.notPushed: annual-leave cash-out (paid as cash) is handled manually in MYOB by finance.
note.prereq: (confirmed by finance): turn on "Use Timesheets to record payroll" in payroll settings, align the week start day with ours, and attach the categories above to each employee's pay details.

payCategories.remaining: {{count}} still to choose; all 5 must be chosen before saving
payCategories.suggestionsUnsaved: Suggested categories are not saved yet; click "Save mapping" once you have checked them
payCategories.saveFailed: Failed to save the pay category mapping

leave.title: Discard the unsaved pay category mapping?
leave.content: You changed the pay category mapping but have not saved it. Leaving now will lose these changes.

switch.title: Discard unsaved changes?
switch.content: The pay category mapping of the current company has unsaved changes. Switching company will lose them.

push.title: Push hours to MYOB · Preview
push.hint: Only the transfer part of hours is pushed; the cash part never goes into MYOB. The preview writes nothing to MYOB.
push.loadFailed: Failed to load the push preview
push.checkHint: Reads MYOB employee by employee, so it is slow; it confirms whether MYOB already has records or a processed pay for this period.
push.goBindAria: Bind {{name}} to a MYOB employee card
push.detailAria: View the daily push detail of {{name}}
push.empty: No hours to push in this period (this company has no employee hours, or hours are not submitted and locked yet)

company.aria: Choose the paying company to preview
company.count: {{count}} paid by this company this period
company.empty: No company file is connected yet. Ask a colleague with the "Connections & mapping" permission to connect and verify one.

notes.crossShare: This company gets {{allocated}} h of transfer allowance (of {{total}} h, split by hours {{ratio}})
notes.crossShareNoRatio: This company gets {{allocated}} h of transfer allowance (of {{total}} h)
notes.leaveFirst: Sick / annual leave is loaded into transfer before weekday
notes.myobCheckFailed: Could not read MYOB; status unknown

unlocked.title: Unlocked stores: {{count}}
unlocked.noneSub: All stores involved are submitted and locked

category.title: Pay categories mapped {{mapped}} / {{total}}
category.incomplete: Hours of unmapped categories cannot be pushed

processed.title: Processed pays in MYOB are not overwritten
processed.unchecked: Not checked: click "Check MYOB status" above to see
processed.some: {{count}} already paid in MYOB; they will not be overwritten
processed.failed: Could not read MYOB for {{count}}; please check again later
processed.none: No processed pay in MYOB for this period

hints.title: {{count}} notes that do not block pushing; please acknowledge each:
hints.ack: I have read the notes above

codes.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_RATE_MISMATCH: Public-holiday rate differs from weekday rate

summary.blockedSuffix: (never skipped silently; they are listed in the result)

drawer.title: {{name}} · Daily push detail
drawer.noDays: No daily data for this period

explain.label: How hours are split:
explain.crossIntro: First the fixed transfer hours are split between the companies by hours worked ({{pairs}}{{ratio}} → {{allocated}}); then, within this company's share, hours are loaded in the order
explain.singleIntro: Fixed transfer hours are loaded in the order
explain.singleOutro: ; whatever does not fit is paid as cash.
explain.orderChain: Sunday → Saturday → Paid leave → Public holiday → Weekday
explain.allTransfer: All-transfer employee: all of this company's actual hours are pushed by day; no transfer allowance is split.
explain.allCash: All-cash employee: no transfer hours, nothing is pushed.

subtitle.mixed: Transfer + cash (fixed transfer {{fixed}}h/wk, this company gets {{allocated}} h)

drawer.actualEmpty: No hours at this company this period
drawer.pushedTitle: Transfer hours to push to MYOB
drawer.pushedNote: Loaded into the transfer allowance in the order shown under "How hours are split"; when a category does not fill, days are filled from earliest to latest, so the last day may be partly filled.
drawer.annualCashOut: A further {{hours}} h of annual-leave cash-out uses up transfer allowance but is not pushed; finance handles it manually in MYOB.

entry.noPermission: Syncing requires the "Employee profiles · Edit" permission

sync.title: Sync profiles from MYOB
sync.readOnly: Read-only on MYOB: nothing in MYOB is changed

step1.fieldsHint: Numbers = bound employees in the current scope
step1.sensitiveNote: Sensitive fields are unchecked by default and must be ticked manually. They are written through the sensitive-data edit path, and an undoable sync record is kept.
step1.modeTitle: When our value exists and differs from MYOB

FillEmpty.title: Fill empty only, never overwrite (recommended)
FillEmpty.desc: Written only when ours is empty. Differences are listed; tick them one by one in the next step.

Overwrite.title: MYOB wins, overwrite all
Overwrite.desc: Differences are ticked by default. A snapshot is kept before writing, so it can be undone.

scope.selectedNamesMore: Ticked in the list: {{names}} and others ({{count}} in total)
scope.allSkip: {{count}} with no MYOB card are skipped automatically
scope.allNoSkip: Applies only to employees that still have a MYOB card
scope.singleDesc: Single-employee sync; the scope is fixed to this one person
scope.rescope: Re-preview only {{name}} (same fields as last time)

step1.noPermission: You do not have the "Employee profiles · Edit" permission, so MYOB data cannot be written to employee profiles. Ask an administrator to grant it.
step1.unavailable: Not readable from MYOB right now

step2.subtitle: Nothing has been written yet · this is a preview, only ticked items are written · Mode: {{mode}}
step2.sensitiveBanner: {{count}} sensitive items ticked (birthday, bank, super). Bank account and super member numbers show only the last 4 digits; the full value is sent only when writing.
step2.sensitiveBannerNone: This preview has {{total}} sensitive items (birthday, bank, super), none ticked. Bank account and super member numbers show only the last 4 digits.
step2.pendingBanner: {{names}} has a pending sensitive-data request, which is voided automatically once sensitive fields are written.
step2.ack: I have checked the sensitive fields (birthday, bank, super)
step2.emptyPreview: No differences to sync for the selected fields in this scope
step2.unavailableBanner: These fields could not be read from MYOB right now (the payment details API may not be permitted), so they are not synced: {{fields}}

step3.subtitle: This sync {{time}} · by {{actor}}
step3.otherLine: {{people}} more people ({{changes}} items) were not written (see below); {{skipped}} needed no sync
step3.otherFailedOnly: {{people}} people ({{changes}} items) were not written (see below)
step3.undoTitle: A snapshot was kept; undo is available for 7 days
step3.undoDesc: Only the fields written in this sync are restored; fields changed by someone since are left alone. After an undo, the record is marked as undone.
step3.undoConfirmContent: The {{changes}} items written for {{people}} people are restored to their previous values. Fields changed by someone after the sync are not restored.
step3.undone: Sync undone: {{changes}} items restored for {{people}} people
step3.undoSkipped: {{count}} items were not restored because they were changed after the sync
step3.footerNote: This sync is recorded; review or undo it under "Sync history"

batch.title: Sync history
batch.hint: The latest 30 syncs; a whole sync can be undone within 7 days

errors.noPermission: No "Employee profiles · Edit" permission, so syncing is not allowed
errors.noFields: Select at least one field to sync
errors.batchNotFound: This sync record was not found
errors.batchAlreadyUndone: This sync has already been undone
errors.batchExpired: This sync is older than 7 days and can no longer be undone
errors.notBound: This employee is no longer bound; nothing was written
errors.cardMissing: The employee's card no longer exists in MYOB; nothing was written
errors.valueChanged: This employee's profile changed after the preview; nothing was written to avoid overwriting their edit
errors.versionConflict: This employee's sensitive data changed after the preview; nothing was written to avoid overwriting their edit
errors.pendingNeedsConfirm: This employee has a pending sensitive-data request; confirm voiding it before writing
errors.writeFailed: Write failed; this employee's profile was not changed

sources.name: MYOB first + last name → our name
sources.phone: Normalised to 04xx xxx xxx before comparing
sources.email: Email is the binding match key; changing it affects future scoring, so it is unchecked by default
sources.birthday: Date of birth in MYOB payroll details
sources.address: Street, city, state and postcode joined on one line
sources.employmentType: Full-time→Full-time · Part-time→Part-time · Casual→Temporary · Other is not synced
sources.bank: BSB + account number (the preview shows only the last 4 digits)
